messages:
anya: Quick data drop from this morning: pricing calc module hover rate is super high but click-through is low. Raw heatmap: https://redwood-internal/heatmaps/497912. Want to brainstorm a micro-nudge to push high-intent users into a live mini-workshop and wire routing.

jess: Can you paste the key metrics here?

anya: Sure 9 calc impressions: 5.1k, calc CTA CTR: 1.9%, hover-to-click ~10:1, avg hover time 3.8s, FAQ expand top question (billing basics) 24% expand. Session samples show many repeat hovers.

carla: Interesting. Hypothesis: folks are window-shopping cost but not confident to request demo. We could try an in-place micro-modal after 2 hovers >2.5s with copy: "See cost at your scale 0min workshop + live Q&A". Tiny form (email + company size) -> lightweight lead.

jess: Love it. Proposed variants: A) "Reserve a spot" (workshop angle) B) "Get a quick cost snapshot" (self-serve calc lead). We'll A/B test which routes to sales faster.

analytics-bot: Note: will need events: rw_calc_hover, rw_calc_modal_shown, rw_calc_modal_cta, rw_calc_modal_submit. Also recommend capturing calc_session_id and page_variant.

sales-ops: Routing idea: if modal_submit AND company_size >= 100 or utm_campaign contains "dedicated", route to SDR queue "pricing-fast-track". Otherwise send to nurture. SLA for pricing-fast-track: contact within 24h, escalate to AE if ARR estimate > $40k.

carla: Can we also include a micro-FAQ link in the modal (1 line) to reduce anxiety? e.g., "What impacts cost most?" -> anchor to FAQ.

anya: Yes. Need copy + 2 variants by EOD. Jess, can you own GTM and analytics hooks? Sales-ops, please create the HubSpot workflow and queue; include a hidden calc_session_id field.

jess: On it. GTM event names as analytics-bot suggested. I'll push a dashboard (calc funnels + routing SLA) by tomorrow.

sales-ops: Creating workflow. Question: do we want to tag leads by variant? e.g., workshop_variant=A/B so SDRs can message accordingly.

carla: Yes tag by variant. Also track which FAQ anchor was clicked for copy feedback.

anya: Great. Dev note: if user is authenticated (email present) pre-fill form and treat as higher intent.

analytics-bot: Deployed a client-side badge to show the workshop CTA on /pricing under utm=pricing-workshop. Monitoring events; will report back in 72h.

jess: I'll include the hover->modal flow in the A/B test and aim for a 7-day run. Metrics: modal_shown rate, modal_submit rate, route_to_sdr rate, contact_time.

anya: Action list: carla 9 modal copy + 2 short variants + micro-FAQ line by 5pm. jess 9 GTM + events + dashboard by EOD tomorrow. sales-ops 9 HubSpot workflow + 24h SLA setup by tomorrow noon. analytics-bot 9 confirm payload includes calc_session_id and prefill for logged-in users.

carla: Copy sketch (workshop): "See Redwood costs at your scale 0-min workshop + live Q&A. Reserve a spot." CTA: "Reserve my spot". Variant B (snapshot): "Get a quick cost snapshot for your workload" CTA: "Get snapshot".

anya: Perfect. Will write the webinar blurb that matches the modal (3 bullets: cost levers, batching/quantization, deployment options) and drop in #marketing for review. :white_check_mark:
